I directly inspected the exact current canonical PNG SHA 15282abd7c2138455d4f34799dfcb80eb869a07901b39cbc58829dc7c7e420a2. The full cabinet is visible with coherent wood panels, black frame, shelves and aligned closed drawers. There is no blank render or visible exploded/missing major part. The single elevated oblique view does not prove hidden geometry, interior clearance, all-view material fidelity or dynamic task behavior.

Native readback reports source unchanged, and run/collect rechecked preparation and all bound input bytes. I independently matched the 12 unique local evidence artifacts and operation-index SHA/size to the collected index. The accepted plan selected exactly the three required provider-free capabilities, with all_required_evidence and no downgraded requirement. Both source asset and packaged dependency have equal before/after hashes.

summary: Root Astra Ultra accepts all four required native standalone Validation gates without waivers or deferrals for the exact Physics10 asset. This is a bounded native schema/render/mounted-runtime result. Final capstone success additionally requires accepted independent native review and the separately corroborated five-seed loaded drawer task on the same SHA.
